notes: Engineers collecting resources, spending a budget, and unlocking hazards and factory upgrades on endless progression is Simulation, and the exaggerated physics, chain reactions and ragdolls are the Physics Sim subgenre almost by definition; Strategy is named second because waves are spawned and hard-coded toward an exit, which is where spawner-npc and the end-of-track structure come from. The shape answer is decisive — each player lays out their own plot from scratch — so plot-isolated, and I swapped it in over Physics Sim's world-open while keeping physics-rig, hazard-kill and path-circulation, since the preset's mode is exactly right and only its shared-world assumption was contradicted. I deliberately did not take Tower Defense or buildzone-grid: the answer rejected one fixed track everyone decorates, so there is no lane flanked by placement strips, and tracker-core is bent to the exit the NPC wave is trying to reach, which also gives the round somewhere to end. Deciding without a user: the room-sized gauntlet scale keeps this one surface with no separate maps, and the NPC route has to be genuinely walkable, so this is a plain P0 build rather than a SET despite players spending the second half watching.
